data.name: Top Drifters
data.detailed_description:
Top Drifters is a top-down arcade racer. With easy to pick up - hard to master simple controls that let you perform impossible turns at great speed. 

It is physics based. Thanks to semi realistic physical forces like torque, gravity and collisions, no two races will ever be the same.

Play solo (campaign mode) or challenge your friends online to become the undisputed Top Drifter. 

Race across more than 20 tracks featuring unconventional "organic" roads, full of twitchy turns, shortcuts, jumps, narrow passageways, tunnels, and a lot of falling off from high places...
Each track features multiple driving surfaces with their unique physics behaviour. Asphalt, dirt, grass, snow and water will affect your car's grip and speed. Will you stay on the road or will you risk taking a shortcut through the slippery grass?

Unlock over 10 cars from different styles and eras (1950s to modern day and even "concept" cars), each with distinct driving stats: speed, acceleration, drifting, turbo recovery, and more. Each car offers a truly unique driving experience so you can experiment and find the one that better suits your driving style. 

For an extra adrenaline kick you have two types of boost at your disposal: one that recharges by drifting, and a powerful, limited-use "nitro", for when you feel confident (or desperate) enough.

Drift hard, boost harder, and become the ultimate Top Drifter!

🔹 Key Features:

  • Top-down arcade racing with vibrant, low-poly visuals

  • Online Multiplayer. Challenge your friends to a healthy and chaotic competition. 

  • Single-player campaign with unlockable cars and in-game achievements.

  • Online Leaderboards. Can you claim the world's Top Drifter throne?

  • Drift-focused gameplay with physics-based handling

  • Two turbo systems: build boost by drifting or unleash limited-use "supersonic" speed

  • 10+ unique cars, each with distinct performance traits and driving style.

  • Multiple game modes: Rally style racing, closed circuit, Gymkhana, and "sandbox" for some chill drifting.

  • Over 20 tracks full of narrow roads, insane turns, jumps, tunnels, falls and shortcuts.

  • Destructible environments, as if races were not chaotic enough...

  • Diverse surfaces: asphalt, dirt, snow, grass, and water will affect your car's grip and speed.

data.short_description: A minimalistic top-down racer with simple old-school arcade controls, Experience physics-based, drift-focused driving at ultra-high-speed. Master 10+ different cars with unique driving stats. Challenge your friends online in 20+ semi-destructible, chaotic races and become the world's "Top Drifter".
